name: PH TRANSMITTER METER
desc: Premium Microprocessor-Based Digital Table-Top pH Transmitter Meter engineered for high-precision electrochemical analysis. Features a wide measuring range from -2.00 to 16.00 pH with Automatic Temperature Compensation (ATC) and an industrial analog current output loop.
features: Broad scale scanning from -2.00 to 16.00 pH lines
Ultra-precise performance verified at ± 0.01 pH variance
Fully automated operational Automatic Temperature Compensation (ATC)
Integrated analog current loop delivering 0/4 to 20 mA signal bands
High-reliability serial RS232 interface output link for data logging

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Benchtop Digital Table-Top pH Transmitter Meter
specifications.Primary Measuring Metrics: Dual sensor input tracking for absolute pH or oxidation-reduction (mV)
specifications.pH Operational Measurement Range: Broad scale scanning from -2.00 to 16.00 pH lines
specifications.Millivolt (mV) Range Scale: Heavy-duty electrical potential tracking up to plus or minus 1999 mV
specifications.pH Measuring Accuracy Index: Ultra-precise performance verified at plus or minus 0.01 pH variance
specifications.Signal Resolution Capacity: High-linearity step tracking index calibrated at 1 mV
specifications.Temperature Compensation: Fully automated operational Automatic Temperature Compensation (ATC)
specifications.System Calibration Protocol: Advanced multi-point configuration matching up to 3 points calibration
specifications.Industrial Process Output: Integrated analog current loop delivering 0/4 to 20 mA signal bands
specifications.Process Loop Safety Alarm: Built-in high-limit loop notification trigger fixed at 22 mA alarm state
specifications.Data Interfacing Port: High-reliability serial RS232 interface output link for data logging
specifications.Display Interface Panel: High-visibility bold multi-parameter Digital display panel
specifications.Power Drive Source: Continuous stable mains performance utilizing 220-230 V AC, 50 Hz line
specifications.Chassis Mechanical Net Mass: Compact stable benchtop structural layout weighing exactly 1.5 Kg
specifications.Target Field Applications: Field Testing, Education, Industrial Automation, Water Testing, and Food Processing
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty on complete electronic matrix
